purpose: the test of the fine-tuned GENCO (notebook T1) against the released model, paired on cases neither model was trained or selected on, and of a warning head that flags cases likely to be unresolved by the specified solver; fixed before any fine-tuned output is seen

verification.note: the frozen policy of F1 (no reactive limits, first converged start); every verdict comes from the solver

test_sets.F1: the 870 contingencies of the frozen final evaluation (N-2 blocks 6 and 16), rebuilt from their stored base points and removed lines
test_sets.footprint: a soft-footprint N-20 case per F1 base point (174), a construction held out of fine-tuning, seed rule default_rng(SEED*1000003 + base + 11)
test_sets.forgetting: released scenarios with released AC solutions: N-2 block 7 and N-10, N-20 block 0, the first 200 of each
test_sets.near_fold: the 120 K1 storms (N-2 blocks 0-1), their tracked-branch fold recomputed as in K1 and their AC truth along K1's load grid

primary_endpoints: 1. clustered cases (F1 nearest/corridor families and footprint): decisions missed by GENCO alone per verified case, paired difference (fine-tuned - released), mean with a 95 % cluster bootstrap interval over base points; also cases with any missed decision (exact McNemar)
2. worst-bus voltage error of GENCO alone on the same cases, paired difference, mean and median, cluster bootstrap
3. forgetting: worst-bus voltage error on the released scenarios, paired difference; non-inferior if the upper 95 % bound of the mean increase is below 0.001 p.u. at each level

4. near the fold: the lowest voltage at the fold (AC, released, fine-tuned) and GENCO's voltage drop over the last 5 % of load as a share of the AC drop, at the AC solution's weakest bus, medians over storms with a fold; beyond the fold Newton from the fine-tuned state must still converge nowhere

5. warning head for cases unresolved by the specified solver (baselines: GENCO's lowest voltage, residual and predicted-violation count alone; logistic regression on GENCO's own outputs and embeddings, trained on T1's training cases, threshold fixed on T1's validation cases for 95% recall of unresolved cases): AUROC, recall and false alarms on F1, footprint and the K1 storms
secondary: Newton iterations from GENCO's state, verdict agreement with the reference, cases resolved only from the fine-tuned state (checked with PYPOWER), the branch check on the fine-tuned workflow, end-to-end GENCO time (unchanged by construction)
